The structure of Cr20N4O20 (Cr5N(O2)5) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 44 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows N centers coordinated by four Cr neighbors, while Cr centers adopt octahedral environments with six O neighbors and Cr centers with four O neighbors. O centers coordinate to two Cr neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 44 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts show Cr octahedra sharing corners and edges.
